title: P0.2 Identity Lifecycle Cross-Repo Certification

permissions.reason: Certification exercises existing identity/session contracts and does not add or alter permission definitions or grants.

frontend.reason: No frontend code or UI behavior changes are introduced.

database.reason: No database model changes are made.

permissions.reason: No permission contract changes are made.

backend.reason: Application backend behavior is unchanged; this phase adds prod-path certification only.

api.reason: No API contract changes are made; existing FAIR CRM auth bridge routes are exercised end to end.

backend_tests.reason: The application test suite is unchanged; the prod-path lifecycle script is the verification target.

deployment.reason: CI-only certification changes require no application deployment.

notes: Runs signup, activation, login, forgot/reset, login, password change and final login through FAIR CRM against real KYROX Core. Core uses its SMTP adapter against an in-process memory-only SMTP sink. Raw action tokens, passwords and session tokens remain process-local and are never logged, persisted or uploaded as artifacts. The gate also verifies one-time token replay rejection and access/refresh session revocation after credential changes.
